title: VNCoffeePrice Dak Lak exploratory one-next-observation backtest
target: Packaged Dak Lak Robusta reference, VND/kg; source provider provenance is incomplete; not a specific dealer transaction quote.
forecast_definition: Next observed row in the source series. Date gaps remain; this is not guaranteed to mean next calendar day or next market session.
source: VNCoffeePrice Mendeley Data v3; see vnc_official_dak_lak_quality.json and attribution/CC BY 4.0 caveat.
feature_policy: Only target history through forecast origin plus forecast-origin calendar fields. No exogenous features are used. Feature functions take a prefix; all rolling windows and lags use past rows only. Calendar values use the origin date, not the future target date.

prediction_interval.reason: Insufficient independently sourced data for calibration; no interval is fabricated.

split.protocol: Calendar-year temporal split from the source partition: initial fitting window through 2024, walk-forward validation in 2025, and walk-forward evaluation in 2026; no random split; horizon one provided observation; no label overlaps. Expanding training window refit every 5 observed targets; intervening predictions use the last fitted model and only known origin features.
split.caveat: 2026 test rows are published and inspected, so the final segment is not a blind final holdout. Metrics are exploratory only; selecting a model on 2025 validation still leaves possible repeated dataset/paper analysis effects.

validation_candidate_rule: Select the model with lowest validation MAE only among models better than persistence on validation; otherwise use persistence.

quality_caveats: The dataset README says the original domestic coffee-price and retail-fuel series provenance was provided to the dataset authors and needs independent verification.
Dataset reports daily observations but has absent calendar dates and some weekend observations; no missing target days were interpolated.
Source splits and reported model results come from the dataset authors; this script independently evaluates Dak Lak only, on its own chronological split.
